facts.value: PROPOSED ONLY: TWC proposed amendment to 40 TAC 815.107 (51 TexReg 5161, 2026-08-07; approved for proposal 2026-07-21, comments to 2026-09-07) would add to the quarterly wage report: wages, industry, occupation field, full/part-time status, county of primary employment, remote-work status (Labor Code 204.0025) and data for the 302.0205 Regional Labor Demand Assessment. Not adopted in the Texas Register adopted-rules issues of 2026-09-25 to 2026-10-30: on 2026-11-02 no field is mandatory and no start quarter is set.

unresolved.why: DOCUMENTED LIMITATION (V11 2026-11-06): Labor Code 204.006(a) pinned: initial rate = greater of the 204.004 major-group rate less one-tenth of one percent, or two and six-tenths percent; 204.005 defines the major-group rate as the average of rates paid in the industry for the year ending Sept 30. The 2026 major-group rates are not in the statute and the TWC rate PDF stays 403, so 2.70 percent cannot be re-derived (it is above the 2.6 floor, which would imply a 2.8 percent major-group rate for the assigned group, but that is an inference, not read from TWC).
